Subject: Redwood — attestation escrow & exchange proposal

Hi Neha,

Thanks again for the call last week. We discussed an automated attestation / evidence escrow flow between GRCentral and Redwood for SOC2 artifacts and pen test reports. Attached is a short spec (GRCentral_Attestation_Spec_v1.pdf) and a draft SOW so your legal/partners team can eyeball scope and timelines.

High-level ask from our side:
- Enable a secure push/pull workflow so our platform can retrieve named artifacts (e.g., SOC2 reports, penetration-test reports, evidence manifests) from a customer-scoped Redwood bucket or connector.
- Support time-limited pre-signed access for artefact retrieval and a webhook for ingestion completion.
- Provide an optional audit trail stub (hash + timestamp) that we can display to auditors.

Suggested timeline: scoping this week, implementation sprint w/c Aug 23, pilot w/c Sep 13.

Also looping in Alice Kumar from our pen test partner (PenTest Co) who will need access to artifact exchange for the initial validation run.

Attachments: GRCentral_Attestation_Spec_v1.pdf; GRCentral_SOW_Draft.docx

Best,
Samir Rao
Head of Integrations — GRCentral
security@grcentral.com
